decisions.reason: As a new safety shoe line in the firm's core category, it fits the company's quality-and-innovation strategy and there is no sign after only one year that it should be withdrawn.
The comfort insole complements the footwear range, supports the firm's focus on tailored worker comfort, and is a sensible accessory for specialist retail and employer customers.
A supportive insole strengthens the firm's offer around fit, protection and foot health, which is consistent with premium industrial footwear positioning in Germany.
The ergonomic safety shoe series appears strategically important because it had its own page and directly supports the firm's innovation-driven push toward better workplace ergonomics.
Firefighter and rescue boots are a credible extension of the firm's protective-footwear expertise and help serve demanding professional niches where reliability matters most.
The moulded insole was prominent enough to be shown on the home page, suggesting commercial priority and strong relevance to the firm's broader footwear system.
